name: Nano Image AI Camera Angle Generator
tagline: Create multiple 2D camera angles from one photo
description: Nano Image is an AI image editing platform with a camera angle generator that creates new 2D views from one uploaded photo. Users can choose front, side, back, three-quarter, bird’s-eye, or close-up perspectives for product photography, ecommerce visuals, character references, and creative image editing. The tool accepts PNG, JPG, WebP, and HEIC images and each camera-angle generation costs 8 credits. The output is a newly generated 2D view, not a true 3D model.
